none: PAS NLM-D1CD55: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Emperor right issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 2.21gms, die axis: 12
